snippet.title: Crabs Must Die! - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the Launch Trailer for Crabs Must Die!, a sci-fi first-person open-world RPG shooter developed by Roman Kharlamov. 

Players will take up arms on an unforgiving planet to take on mutated crabs, scavenge for supplies, and survive at all costs. Crabs Must Die! is launching on November 6 for PC (Steam).

#CrabsMustDie #FPS #RPG
